verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a developer framework feature like Mastra Knowledge, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any way to disable them. Storing data in the user's own configured storage provider is an adjacent data-residency point, not a telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
